summary: The note describes how the Fairview Community Learning Center tackled declining volunteer participation by launching the Volunteer Empowerment Initiative in 2023. The program combines onboarding, mentors, a peer-led Volunteer Council, tailored training, continuous-learning requirements and recognition through a monthly Volunteer Spotlight. The center aims to build a culture of continuous improvement and sustained civic engagement.
one_line: Fairview Community Learning Center boosts volunteer retention through onboarding, mentoring, a Volunteer Council, tailored training and recognition under its Volunteer Empowerment Initiative.
key_facts: Fairview Community Learning Center (CLC) is located on the east side of the city and serves individuals of all ages.
Volunteer participation at Fairview historically surged at the start of the year but dwindled by March, according to Jane Smith.
Jane Smith has been Director of Volunteer Services at Fairview since November 2023.
Underlying problems included poor communication about the importance of consistent commitment and insufficient training.
Long-time volunteer Michael Johnson said at a September 15, 2023 forum that volunteers can feel like "a small cog in a large machine" without seeing their impact.
Volunteers also cited lack of recognition, inadequate support and unclear roles as barriers to sustained engagement.
The Volunteer Empowerment Initiative (VEI) launched on September 25, 2023, emphasizing comprehensive onboarding, detailed role descriptions and a volunteer support system.
New volunteers attend orientation sessions on the CLC mission and are each assigned an experienced mentor.
Susan Rodriguez, volunteer coordinator, inaugurated the Volunteer Council on December 3, 2023; it consists entirely of active volunteers and meets monthly.
Tailored training programs launched in January 2024 for roles such as tutoring, administrative work and facility maintenance, with advanced workshops for longer-term volunteers.
As of February 2024, volunteers are invited to attend at least one skill-upgrade session or community-building workshop each quarter, which has boosted retention substantially.
The monthly 'Volunteer Spotlight' recognition program started on January 19, 2024.
Thomas Kelley, a senior volunteer who conducts history seminars, said seeing his friend Lara featured for her literacy class efforts inspired him.
The note says CLCs like Fairview are shifting from occasional volunteerism to centers of sustained civic engagement.
